title: SKYDGETS — Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform with AI-Powered Automation
shortDescription: A feature-rich full-stack e-commerce platform built with Next.js 15, Express, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS. Features dynamic product catalogs, guest checkout merging, real-time order tracking, and Gemini-powered AI automation.
fullDescription: SKYDGETS is a state-of-the-art full-stack e-commerce platform designed for tech gadgets. It features dynamic product catalogs with category-specific attribute schemas (phones, PC components, accessories), real-time search, multi-field filtering, sorting, pagination, and guest checkout support with seamless account merging upon login. The backend implements a layered architecture (routes → controllers → services → repositories) secured with Better Auth (Google OAuth + JWT). Crucially, SKYDGETS integrates AI-powered automation using the Google Gemini API: a Smart Listing Assistant (image analysis, auto-categorization, description generation, data-driven price suggestions) and a streaming AI Shopping Assistant with live catalog search and order lookup tools.
challenges: Designing flexible category-specific attribute schemas in MongoDB to handle diverse product specifications (phones, PC hardware, accessories).
Integrating real-time streaming tool-calling AI agents for instant catalog search, order status lookups, and personalized shopping recommendations.
Architecting smooth guest checkout transitions and seamless account-merging logic upon post-checkout login or OAuth sign-in.
futurePlans: Expand to multi-vendor marketplace functionality with merchant analytics dashboards.
Implement AI visual similarity search using product embeddings.
Integrate automated inventory demand forecasting using historical order trends.
